newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei to buy Olympic Sports fitness club chain.
newsitem.headline: Daiei to buy Olympic Sports fitness club chain.

text.p: Major Japanese supermarket chain operator Daiei Inc said on Friday that it would take over a fitness club chain belonging to failed Olympic Sports Co on March 1.

A Daiei spokeswoman declined to comment on the amount of the purchase, but the Japanese daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported in its evening edition on Friday that Daiei would buy the chain for about four billion yen.
The purchase will be made through Daiei's wholly owned subsidiary, Daiei Leisure Land Inc, which also operates a chain of fitness clubs.
Olympic Sports was declared bankrupt by the Nagoya District Court in November. It had outstanding debts of 35.51 billion yen.
As of the end of March 1996, it had 92 sporting goods stores and 21 fitness clubs, mostly in the central and northern parts of Japan.
